💰 FinOps Pricing Model, Free Tier & CUDs

Billing Model: Consumption-Based Pay-As-You-Go
Metered Units: Active resource-hours • API operations • GiB ingested
Free Tier: Eligible Initial monthly free tier quota available on many operations/observability APIs
Committed Use Discounts: On-Demand (Spend CUDs where supported)
Key Cost Watchouts:
  • High-cardinality log/metric ingestion & retention (>30 days)
  • Regional price multiplier differences across Tier 1 vs Tier 3 regions
  • Automated polling frequency on high-scale APIs
